GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 421.4 (25 Oct 45) GA
(SCAPIN-192)
APO 500
25 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Removal of Insignia by Demobilized Japanese Armed Forces.
Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 421.4 (19 Oct 45) GA, dated 20 October 1945, subject: “Removal of Insignia by Demobilized Japanese Armed Forces”, is rescinded and the following substituted therefor:
“It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government issue orders causing all demobilized members of the Japanese Armed Forces to remove insignia indicating previous rank and army or branch of service. All military and naval personnel remaining in the armed service will remove such insignia upon demobilization.”
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
